capabilities: Download video and audio from pasted links using presets (MP4, MP3, WAV, clips, GIFs)
Search YouTube and manage a download queue with progress and retries
Embed finished downloads into notes via templates or create notes with properties
Extract time-range clips and optimized GIFs, and download or clean subtitles
Block and unblock sites system-wide by editing the Windows hosts file
extras: Desktop only, made and tested first on Windows 10/11. The plugin can install the required command-line tools itself (with SHA-256 verification) and auto-update yt-dlp. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a Windows hosts-file manager that needs administrator prompts and can block YouTube system-wide.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to download web videos or audio into a vault; users would have to run command-line tools like yt-dlp and ffmpeg themselves and move files manually.

relations.evidence: Download video and audio from YouTube and hundreds of other sites with yt-dlp, right from your notes
Merging video and audio, converting audio, clips, GIFs, embedding subtitles.
The JavaScript runtime yt-dlp needs for full YouTube support.

summary: Graphical interface for yt-dlp that downloads video and audio from YouTube and other sites into the vault, with presets, clips, GIFs and note embedding.
